description: Connected, customizable apps for ChatGPT, Claude and standalone web.

interface.longDescription: Use ready-made TrialAgents apps, customize them with AI assistants, or build custom apps for your team. TrialAgents is cross-platform software for ChatGPT, Claude and standalone web, sharing authorized data, access controls and saved app versions. Preview completed changes and save within approved permissions. Optional scheduled research currently uses ChatGPT; email actions use TrialAgents, with readiness verified separately. Connect a TrialAgents account to create and save apps. Not intended for patient-level data or regulated clinical decision-making.

prompts: Build and save a company outreach tracker with linked companies and contacts.
Update my saved outreach tracker every Friday and email me after each completed update.

positive.description: Fresh installation and new TrialAgents account, no prior grants or cached connection. Complete normal host sign-in and consent.
positive.expected_behavior: Show connection when signed out; after connection resume Home with the correct account and one initialized account database. Do not create an app, ask the user to name an internal workspace, or expose another account.

positive.description: Connected clean test tenant; no company/contact tables. Synthetic business data only.

positive.expected_behavior: Use a suitable current template and real relationship bindings. Prepare one request-keyed draft; finalize once; save the exact finalized digest within this request. Return a save receipt and one app on Home. Examples stay unsaved; schema and app commit together.

positive.expected_behavior: If no template fits, create an isolated custom app with empty data bindings. Supported controls calculate from user input. No separate authentication, invented connector or unnecessary table. Validate, finalize and save one app.

publication.release_notes: Move templates and detailed workflow contracts to server-owned resources; retain two focused routing skills with a synchronized design baseline. Preserve renderer assets, current templates, IDs, permissions and workflows. Unify finalized-preview guidance, full-table queries and MCP bootstrap instructions; declare OAuth discovery and complete tool annotations.
